bullets: [𝐄𝐀𝐒𝐘 𝐁𝐑𝐄𝐖 𝐅𝐎𝐑 𝟏-𝟐 𝐂𝐔𝐏𝐒]– Designed for single servings, this pour over coffee dripper accommodates 15g of coffee grounds for 1-2 cups. The collapsible design saves space without sacrificing brewing quality – ideal as a travel pour over coffee maker.

[𝐂𝐎𝐌𝐏𝐋𝐄𝐓𝐄 𝐖𝐈𝐓𝐇 𝐒𝐓𝐎𝐑𝐀𝐆𝐄 𝐁𝐀𝐆 ]– This collapsible pour over coffee maker comes with a durable storage pouch designed with a small buckle. The spacious interior accommodates the folding coffee dripper along with filter paper (not included) – all in one compact travel kit.

[𝐏𝐄𝐑𝐅𝐄𝐂𝐓 𝐅𝐎𝐑 𝐓𝐑𝐀𝐕𝐄𝐋 & 𝐂𝐀𝐌𝐏𝐈𝐍𝐆]– Weighing only 110g, this travel coffee dripper is ultra-lightweight. The camping pour over coffee dripper fits easily in backpacks or RV drawers. Whether camping, hiking, or backpacking, enjoy fresh coffee anywhere.

[𝐂𝐎𝐋𝐋𝐀𝐏𝐒𝐈𝐁𝐋𝐄 𝐏𝐎𝐔𝐑 𝐎𝐕𝐄𝐑 𝐂𝐎𝐅𝐅𝐄𝐄 𝐃𝐑𝐈𝐏𝐏𝐄𝐑] – Made of food-grade 304 stainless steel, this collapsible coffee dripper folds flat for compact storage. The folding pour over coffee dripper is durable, rustproof, and dishwasher safe – simply rinse after use.

[𝐒𝐓𝐀𝐁𝐈𝐋𝐈𝐓𝐘 𝐓𝐈𝐏𝐒 𝐅𝐎𝐑 𝐁𝐄𝐒𝐓 𝐑𝐄𝐒𝐔𝐋𝐓𝐒] – For optimal stability with this portable pour over coffee dripper: ① Pre-wet the filter to adhere fully to the cone. ② Use ≤15g coffee grounds. ③ Pour water in a steady center stream to avoid uneven stress. Practice makes perfect!
